skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand and explain compensation management concepts and structures.
Analyze factors influencing compensation including external environment, organizational factors, job characteristics, and individual attributes.
Apply selection criteria when designing a compensation system.
Design and apply a legal, fair, and organizationally aligned compensation system.
Integrate knowledge and skills to analyze real-world situations, identify issues, and propose solutions for compensation management problems.
Demonstrate effective written and oral communication skills, teamwork, independent work, self-study, and research abilities.
Actively participate in group work and contribute effectively.
Present and discuss compensation management topics effectively.
